notes: «عن أبيه، قال وحدث أبو عثمان أيضا عن عبد الرحمن»: the speaker is أبيه (relation), and «وحدث أبو عثمان» continues the same route from him, so it is one route, not a second group (a reader who takes «أيضا» as a parallel route would add a second group)
the Companion عبد الرحمن بن أبي بكر is the last link; the saying is his report
